input_order: canonical route/epoch ordering; points canonicalized by time_ns/sample_sha256, with original within-epoch order required strictly increasing
duplicate_sample_policy: reject globally, including cross-route or cross-epoch duplicates
duplicate_route_policy: reject duplicate cluster records; nested epochs share a single route record
exclusion_rules: reject wrong role, source pin, sign, requested rather than applied stage, units or delay count
reject missing/invalid route, epoch, sample, provenance or source identity
reject duplicate samples, overlapping route segments, inconsistent boundaries and nonincreasing within-epoch time
classify each epoch independently; never qualify through pooled coverage
missing artifacts are UNAVAILABLE; no new raw extraction or substitute timestamps permitted
compute descriptive pooled/route/epoch/side diagnostics for admitted observations, retaining all invalid-coverage flags
do not choose favorable routes, fits or sensitivities after seeing results
synthetic_domain: mathematical source-equation diagnostic domain, not vehicle ranges; unfiltered raw SVD cases do not imply native selection validity

synthetic_acceptance.tolerance_rationale: float64 roundoff allowance for the declared bounded deterministic affine/moment fixtures; not a physical tolerance or application bound
synthetic_acceptance.friction_direct_identity: reject universal identity when analytic/noise/occupancy counterexamples exist
synthetic_acceptance.degenerate_data: reject rather than issue a numerical estimate

uncertainty_method: exhaustive delete-one-route jackknife descriptive standard error
minimum_cluster_rationale: at least three leave-one-route fits, each retaining at least two route clusters; an operational diagnostic prerequisite, not an asymptotic confidence guarantee
leave_one_route_out: all routes, report slope/offset/spread deltas and relative slope delta
leave_one_epoch_out: all epochs, boundary/clock/segment sensitivity only; not independent N
factor_qualification_rule: all analytic, synthetic, sensitivity, authenticated signal-selection, per-epoch native validity, independent-cluster inference, justified route stability and linear-mode gates must pass; missing or unjustified gate blocks
friction_qualification_rule: separate controller estimand and native-spread relationship, universal recovery/transform and noise separation must be established before qualification; factor success never qualifies friction
joint_identifiability_rule: assess unrestricted observed x/y with latent friction state, measurement errors and nuisance intercept separately from ideal conditional factor identity
posthoc_analysis_status: EXPLORATORY_ONLY; cannot alter this frozen primary policy
